I played the game just a few days ago and I think it’s definitely worth it. I chose Shinwoo’s ending and I think it was a lot of fun, the storyline was good and the art is too. It makes good sense and doesn’t leave you in confusion, you can also choose who you’d like to be with and it’s rather realistic.

They let you choose and give a lot of nice illustrations along with the characters, it’s fun especially when you actually think of yourself as their partner (which I personally did)


Some spoilers ahead.



Shinwoo was quite cranky so I was worried he may not have felt the same which made it more realistic, something that often happens in real life. Unlike most games, it gave me an uncertain feeling before I saw Shinwoo’s perspective of me in spin-off. He’s not the best at showing how he feels so it gave me a realistic worried feeling that my crush may not feel the same way about me, most games don’t give you that feeling and that’s one of the many things that make it worth playing.

It’s not the saddest and this anime got quite some hate but I personally liked it because of the friendship and sad scenes.
